flicker_kit.name: Flickerkit
flicker_kit.description: A cute kitten made of flickering flames.

ember_paw.name: Emberpaw
ember_paw.description: A fiery young lion whose glowing paws leave embers in every footprint.

inferoar.name: Inferoar
inferoar.description: A proud flame-maned lion that can turn a battlefield into a shimmering heat haze.

iron_imp.name: Ironimp
iron_imp.description: A mischievous little imp with a body of polished iron.

shard_hound.name: Shardhound
shard_hound.description: A loyal hound whose crystalline coat sheds razor-sharp splinters.

steelmaw.name: Steelmaw
steelmaw.description: A hulking wolf forged around an endlessly spinning storm of blades.

spriglet.name: Spriglet
spriglet.description: A shy sapling creature that leaves a trail of fresh green shoots.

vine_lash.name: Vinelash
vine_lash.description: A nimble forest cat with living vines woven through its tail.

verdantail.name: Verdantail
verdantail.description: An ancient guardian whose mane summons a whirling canopy of leaves.

pebbit.name: Pebbit
pebbit.description: A round little golem that collects interesting stones in its pockets.

quakeling.name: Quakeling
quakeling.description: A sure-footed ram whose every stomp makes the ground hum.

cragodon.name: Cragodon
cragodon.description: A mountain-backed beast strong enough to split a cliff with one charge.

droplet.name: Droplet
droplet.description: A bubbly little fish that can dart through the air on a stream of water.

surgefin.name: Surgefin
surgefin.description: A swift sea-serpent whose fins carry the pull of the tide.

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.description: A colossal deep-water serpent that follows the oldest ocean currents.

glimmer.name: Glimmer
glimmer.description: A curious sprite that shines brightest when someone needs guidance.

solaris.name: Solaris
solaris.description: A radiant fox with a warm glow that chases shadows from the wilds.

luminar.name: Luminar
luminar.description: A winged guardian that scatters brilliant motes with every beat of its wings.

photonix.name: Photonix
photonix.description: A blazing celestial bird that crosses the sky as a streak of living light.

shadelet.name: Shadelet
shadelet.description: A tiny shadow that peeks from beneath moonlit doorways.

gloamclaw.name: Gloamclaw
gloamclaw.description: A silent panther that blurs into darkness before it pounces.

dreadmoth.name: Dreadmoth
dreadmoth.description: A velvet-winged moth whose dust turns uneasy dreams into waking visions.

umbrael.name: Umbrael
umbrael.description: A regal dragon that gathers every nearby shadow beneath its obsidian wings.

riftling.name: Riftling
riftling.description: A curious creature that pops in and out of tiny portals.

orbiton.name: Orbiton
orbiton.description: A floating orb-beast orbited by pebbles pulled from distant worlds.

wormwyrm.name: Wormwyrm
wormwyrm.description: A long, starlit wyrm that coils through wormholes between faraway places.

singularis.name: Singularis
singularis.description: A dense, dark creature with a tiny galaxy turning at its core.

galaxar.name: Galaxar
galaxar.description: A cosmic titan whose constellation-marked hide holds the light of vanished stars.

ticktail.name: Ticktail
ticktail.description: A quick little lizard with a clock-face pattern at the tip of its tail.

chronohare.name: Chronohare
chronohare.description: A long-eared runner that seems to arrive just before it starts moving.

epochwyrm.name: Epochwyrm
epochwyrm.description: A serpentine dragon that slips through the seams between one moment and the next.

fatespinner.name: Fatespinner
fatespinner.description: A many-legged oracle that weaves glowing threads of possible futures.

destinarch.name: Destinarch
destinarch.description: An ageless guardian that watches the past and future unfold at once.
